model_and_devices.selected_model: NMOS_IDEAL Level 1, VTO=0.7 V, KP=0.0002 A/V^2, LAMBDA=0.02 1/V
model_and_devices.M0_sampling: W=10 um L=1 um m=1, VIN1/VCLK1/net3/VSS
model_and_devices.M1_buffer: W=10 um L=1 um m=1, VDD/net3/VOUT1/VSS

evaluation_policy.transfer_reference: unity external VIN1 reference by explicit user policy; source-follower offset remains performance error
evaluation_policy.functional_gate: existing V1 observable Track response and Hold isolation; offset alone is not functional failure

conditions.vin_range_basis: conditional engineering test span equal to archived SIN(1.2,0.3,100k) extrema; not verified operating limits
conditions.vin_edge_basis: conditional finite PWL edge, chosen to fit 5 ns clock edges and measurement windows
conditions.load_basis: R0 original source + ideal_param.yaml; no added load
conditions.clock_basis: archived PULSE(0 3.3 50ns 5ns 5ns 750ns 1us); delay moved to 0 and plateau reduced 5ns to align V1 switch_off at 750ns; both changes are conditional fixture decisions
conditions.temperature_basis: conditional engineering room-temperature test; no frozen source temperature
conditions.startup_basis: V1 protocol only; archived VOUT1 nodeset is not assumed required; authentic startup must be inspected

condition_provenance.vin_range_v: conditional engineering from archived VIN1 SIN extrema; not a verified limit
condition_provenance.clock_period_s: archived ideal transient PULSE period 1 us
condition_provenance.clock_duty: conditional 0.75 fixture Track fraction aligned to historical 750 ns high-scale
condition_provenance.clock_edges_s: archived ideal transient PULSE 5 ns rise/fall

waveforms.VIN1: finite PWL: startup 1.2 V; per measured cycle reset to inward quarter-range, 5 ns Track step to target, 5 ns Hold disturbance inward
waveforms.VCLK1: one periodic 0/3.3 V PULSE; rise 5 ns, high plateau 745 ns, fall 5 ns, period 1 us, first rise at t=0

measurement.event_origin: relative to each measured cycle's Track start; V1 build_fixture formula, subject to offline recomputation

unresolved_required_before_real_run: operator acceptance of conditional fixture/test span

readiness: fixture values specified for operator review; NOT approved for real execution
